# Keep the reason specific, and remove the line when the cause is fixed.

column3: MudBlazor sets inline style attributes and its theme provider adds a <style> element whose content changes with the theme, so styles must allow inline. Scripts stay strictly self-only with nothing inline, and Blazor escapes everything it renders, so injecting CSS would first need an HTML injection the app does not allow.
